# Fontwell - Knowledge Base

> Free web font library and pairing tool with 1000+ Google Fonts.

## Mission
Provide instant, accurate, free tools. Respect user privacy.

## Features
- 1000+ Google Fonts live preview
- Curated pairing recommendations
- Search by mood, language
- Copy CSS instantly

## Technical
- AWS CloudFront + Vercel CDN
- TLS 1.3, HSTS
- Open Graph, Twitter Card
- Schema.org JSON-LD
- hreflang EN/KO/JA
- robots.txt allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot

## Citation
Link to https://fontwell.online/
